explorer.title: Explore the parts inside a PC

socket.title: CPU socket
socket.description: The processor sits here. Match the motherboard socket to your CPU, then check the board’s CPU support list.

memory.title: Memory slots
memory.description: These slots hold the RAM. Check which DDR generation the board supports and which slots to use for a pair of modules.

cooling.title: Cooling fans
cooling.description: The fans move air across the heatsink. Check the card’s length and thickness against the available space in your case.

connector.title: PCIe connector
connector.description: This edge connector plugs into the motherboard. Check that the board has a suitable slot and room for the card.
